counterfactual_missing_items: features typical of basal cell carcinoma
histologic confirmation of the residual papules
decisive_items: An excisional biopsy of the lesion showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis; there was no clear evidence of basaloid nests, and the diagnosis rendered was invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate anchored to the definitive histologic diagnosis and explicitly excludes basaloid nests. R2 relies on non-diagnostic dermoscopic features of residual papules and conflicts with the excisional biopsy. C1 is a close temporal completion of R1, but partial metabolic response is a treatment-response status rather than a diagnosis, so R1 remains the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: Dermoscopic features typical of BCC in residual papules are not histologically confirmed and are discordant with the original excisional biopsy showing no basaloid nests and a rendered diagnosis of invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
